name: @heroku-mcp/admin-cli
stderr:
Usage: herokumcp-admin [options] [command]

Admin CLI for the hosted Heroku MCP server. Operates against the same Postgres
the HTTP server uses.

Options:
  -V, --version     output the version number
  -h, --help        display help for command

Commands:
  users             List and inspect users.
  tokens            Manage MCP connection tokens.
  audit             Query and prune the audit log.
  status [options]  Print deployment health: DB reachability, token count,
                    master-key fingerprint.
  db                Run / inspect schema migrations.
  keys              Master-key utilities.
  help [command]    display help for command
